posts.post: We make everything on demand because having piles of unsold clothes in a warehouse is embarrassing. It is about wearing what you actually want instead of feeding a landfill. Am I the only one who thinks this is the bare minimum?
Minimalism has become an excuse to be boring. If your outfit does not have a single interesting detail or texture, you are just wearing a uniform. Agree or am I reaching?
Stop buying a new outfit every weekend just for the grid. A closet full of intentional pieces that actually fit your vibe is a bigger flex than any micro-trend. Agree or am I reaching?
